criteria.feedback: Missing or incorrect prediction. Trace the example and check JSON types, then retry.

criteria.description: Write a standard-library unittest for sale totals with 200*3=600, zero stock value and another price. Show the exact discovery command and results. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Add tests rejecting zero, negative, fractional and excessive sale quantities. Assert unchanged stock for every rejected case. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use a temporary database/file fixture and verify a saved product can be reloaded. Keep tests independent from your working inventory. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use DRF APIClient for valid creation 201, invalid creation 400 and missing detail 404. Check response fields and row counts. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Create two users and prove one cannot read or change the other’s products. Include a direct request using a guessed valid ID. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Replace the external payment boundary with a fake returning success or failure. Check a failure does not deduct stock; no network calls should be needed. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Temporarily introduce an incorrect comparison at the stock boundary in a disposable copy. Show a relevant test fails, restore the correct implementation and show it passes. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
